title: Activists oppose Google's new UK data center plan
excerpt: Motorcyclists and insect conservationists are teaming up to protest a planned Google data center east of London.
body_html:
A diverse group of campaigners is working together to block Google from constructing a sprawling new data center east of London. The coalition includes both motorcyclists and bug enthusiasts who are joining forces to oppose the facility.

This local opposition comes as similar data center protests begin breaking out across Europe. Campaigners are raising concerns about the large developments, though specific details regarding the protests and the facility's exact impact remain part of the ongoing local resistance against the tech infrastructure project.
